_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Inventory valuation schema supporting FIFO and weighted-average costing methods. Lifecycle guards prevent method switching when stock quantity is non-zero. Declarative x-openregister-lifecycle handles status transitions; x-openregister-relations links to Product and CostCenter; x-openregister-rbac controls bookkeeper/auditor access. No app-local valuation service — all costing logic is schema-declarative per ADR-031.

InventoryValuation.title: Inventory Valuation
InventoryValuation.description: Records the monetary valuation of an inventory position for a specific product, warehouse, and costing method (FIFO or weighted average). One record per product-warehouse-method combination per valuation run. Costing-method changes are blocked when on-hand quantity exceeds zero (REQ-INV-003).

quantity.description: On-hand quantity of the product at the time of valuation.

unitCost.description: Cost per unit with up to 4 decimal places precision (supports sub-cent costing for bulk goods).

totalValue.description: Total inventory value (quantity × unitCost), rounded to 2 decimal places.

valuationMethod.description: Costing method applied: FIFO (first-in first-out) or weighted average. Changing method when quantity > 0 is blocked by InventoryValuationMethodGuard (REQ-INV-003).

date.description: Datetime at which this valuation snapshot was taken.

warehouse.description: Warehouse or storage location identifier. Optional; null means the default administration warehouse.

status.description: Lifecycle status. active: current valuation; adjusted: under manual correction; obsolete: archived, excluded from active stock value summaries.

productId.description: FK to the Product schema record this valuation belongs to.

costCenterId.description: FK to the CostCenter this inventory value should be allocated to.

pendingCogs.description: Flag set to true when the GL configuration required to book Cost of Goods Sold is missing. Allows the valuation to be recorded while the finance team completes the chart-of-accounts mapping.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this valuation record.

active.label: Active
active.description: Current, authoritative valuation. Included in stock-value aggregations and COGS calculations.

adjusted.label: Adjusted
adjusted.description: Valuation is under manual correction. Excluded from automated COGS booking until confirmed.

obsolete.label: Obsolete
obsolete.description: Archived valuation. Retained for audit trail; excluded from active stock value summaries.

adjust.label: Mark as adjusted
adjust.description: Flag this valuation for manual correction. Use when a discrepancy is detected that requires review before the next COGS run.

confirm.label: Confirm correction complete
confirm.description: Return the valuation to active after manual adjustment has been verified and accepted.

obsolete_from_active.label: Archive
obsolete_from_active.description: Archive an active valuation. Blocked when on-hand quantity is greater than zero to prevent silent stock write-offs.

obsolete_from_adjusted.label: Archive
obsolete_from_adjusted.description: Archive an adjusted valuation. Blocked when on-hand quantity is greater than zero.

methodChange.label: Change valuation method
methodChange.description: Switch FIFO ↔ average. Blocked when quantity > 0.

product.description: The Product whose stock position this valuation record describes.

costCenter.description: The CostCenter to which this inventory value is allocated.
